teaser.en: A spiny, papery-barked myrrh relative that Digo people recognise by its three-part leaves and its stem.
teaser.sw: Jamaa wa manemane mwenye miiba na gome kama karatasi, ambaye Wadigo humtambua kwa majani yake ya vipande vitatu na shina lake.

summary.en: Mdandachindi is a straggling, spiny Commiphora shrub with papery bark and leaves in threes. It is a relative of mbambara and the other myrrhs of the dry coast.
summary.sw: Mdandachindi ni kichaka cha *Commiphora* kinachotawanyika ovyo, chenye miiba, gome kama karatasi na majani ya vijani vitatu vitatu. Ni jamaa wa mbambara na mimea mingine ya manemane ya pwani kavu.

about.en: Mdandachindi is a straggling shrub or small tree up to about 7 metres tall, smooth and hairless. Its spine-tipped branches carry smooth, dark green or grey bark that is thin and papery. The leaves are divided into three leaflets on a stalk up to 6 cm long. Like other *Commiphora*, it has resinous tissues and small fruits that split to show a stone partly wrapped in a coloured fleshy cup. Digo people identify it by its leaves and stem.
about.sw: Mdandachindi ni kichaka kinachotawanyika ovyo au mti mdogo wenye urefu wa hadi mita 7 hivi, laini na usio na manyoya. Matawi yake yenye ncha za miiba yana gome laini la kijani kilichokolea au kijivu, jembamba na kama karatasi. Majani yamegawanyika kuwa vijani vitatu juu ya kikonyo chenye urefu wa hadi sm 6. Kama *Commiphora* nyingine, una tishu zenye utomvu wa ubani na matunda madogo yanayopasuka kuonyesha kokwa iliyofunikwa kwa sehemu na kikombe cha nyama chenye rangi. Wadigo huutambua kwa majani na shina lake.

where.en: It grows in dry bushland and thicket, in the seasonally dry country from south-east Congo to south-east Kenya and northern Mozambique.
where.sw: Hukua katika nyika ya vichaka na vichaka vikavu, katika nchi yenye ukame wa majira kuanzia kusini-mashariki mwa Kongo hadi kusini-mashariki mwa Kenya na kaskazini mwa Msumbiji.

culture.en: Pakia notes that the peeling bark (*guwika*) of *Commiphora* is one of the few bark features distinctive enough for Digo people to use in identifying plants.
culture.sw: Pakia anabainisha kwamba gome linalobambuka (*guwika*) la *Commiphora* ni mojawapo ya sifa chache za gome zilizo wazi kiasi cha Wadigo kuzitumia katika kutambua mimea.

names.en: Digo: *mdandachindi*. Pakia records it only for Digo, gives no meaning, and records no English or Swahili name. Other Digo *Commiphora* include *mbambara* (*C. africana*), *mdege* (*C. zanzibarica*) and *mryakwembe* (*C. edulis*).
names.sw: Kidigo: *mdandachindi*. Pakia analirekodi kwa Kidigo tu, hatoi maana yake, wala harekodi jina la Kiingereza au Kiswahili. *Commiphora* nyingine za Kidigo ni pamoja na *mbambara* (*C. africana*), *mdege* (*C. zanzibarica*) na *mryakwembe* (*C. edulis*).

reason.en: Mbambara, African myrrh, in the same genus
reason.sw: Mbambara, manemane ya Afrika, wa jenasi hiyo hiyo
